contran_945.message: Only straps, chains, blocking or mats secure the load.
The load is held by blocking or the body's walls, not by lashings.
Each unit is secured with at least 4 lashing terminals.
Lashings are anchored to the truck's lashing points on the metal frame.
No room to travel along the truck, or diagonal devices hold the load.
Diagonal devices or blocking hold every unit forward and backward.
No cargo uses an open body's headboard as a stop.
Nothing above the headboard can slide forward over it.

No cargo is in contact with the front end structure.

Tiedowns are hooked to the truck's anchor points.
No ropes.

securing.message: Held forward at 0.8 g.
Not held sideways at 0.5 g: the securing holds 94% of the cargo.

Every unit is stable on its own (EN 12195-1 eq. 3).
A flatbed's headboard has no EN 12642 code given.
No cargo leans on a flatbed's headboard.
Rated web lashings or chains, marked with their LC and STF.
The lashing points hold what the lashings pull.
